members: public ReorderHistoryService(TelemetryHistoryRepository repository, HistoryEventPublisher publisher, AuditTrail auditTrail, TelemetryMeters meters, TelemetryProperties properties, Clock clock) { this.repository = repository; this.publisher = publisher; this.auditTrail = auditTrail; this.meters = meters; this.properties = properties; this.clock = clock; }

private Mono<Void> store(TelemetrySample sample, String correlationId, Optional<Instant> latest) { return repository.appendSample(sample).flatMap(id -> stage(id, sample, correlationId, latest).then(Mono.defer(() -> bufferWindow(sample, correlationId)))); }

private Mono<Void> stage(long id, TelemetrySample sample, String correlationId, Optional<Instant> latest) { Duration lateness = Duration.between(sample.tDevice(), sample.tIngress()); if (lateness.compareTo(properties.reorderWindow()) > 0) { return repository.appendRevision(id, RevisionReason.BACKFILL, sample.value(), sample.tIngress()).flatMap(revisionNo -> { meters.revisionAppended(RevisionReason.BACKFILL); log.info("revision appended"); return audit(AuditAction.APPEND_REVISION, "SUCCESS", correlationId).then(publisher.publish(new HistoryEvent(HistoryEventType.REVISION_APPENDED, sample, revisionNo, 0, correlationId))); }).onErrorResume(error -> failed(AuditAction.APPEND_REVISION, correlationId, error)); } if (latest.isPresent() && latest.get().isAfter(sample.tDevice())) { return Mono.defer(() -> { meters.sampleReordered(sample.metric()); log.info("sample reordered within backfill window"); return publisher.publish(new HistoryEvent(HistoryEventType.SAMPLE_BACKFILLED, sample, 0, 0, correlationId)); }).onErrorResume(error -> failed(AuditAction.BROADCAST_WINDOW, correlationId, error)); } return Mono.empty(); }

private Mono<Void> bufferWindow(TelemetrySample sample, String correlationId) { Instant from = sample.tDevice().minus(properties.reorderWindow()); return repository.findWindow(sample.deviceId(), sample.metric(), from, sample.tDevice(), properties.reorderBufferCapacity()).count().flatMap(size -> { log.info("window buffered"); return publisher.publish(new HistoryEvent(HistoryEventType.WINDOW_BUFFERED, sample, 0, size.intValue(), correlationId)).then(audit(AuditAction.BROADCAST_WINDOW, "SUCCESS", correlationId)); }).onErrorResume(error -> failed(AuditAction.BROADCAST_WINDOW, correlationId, error)); }

private Mono<Void> audit(AuditAction action, String outcome, String correlationId) { return Mono.defer(() -> auditTrail.record(new AuditEntry(ACTOR, action, outcome, clock.instant(), correlationId))); }

private Mono<Void> failed(AuditAction action, String correlationId, Throwable error) { return audit(action, "FAILURE", correlationId).onErrorResume(auditError -> Mono.empty()).then(Mono.<Void>error(error)); }
